Forum build guide:  https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2181275

Youtube: http://youtube.com/KayGaming

Build guide video: https://youtu.be/nklMyb4qSYQ

Twitter:  https://twitter.com/Kaygaming12

Patreon: https://patreon.com/Kaygaming12

--

This build is: Minion Army Necromancer - League Starter & SSF

The base build is designed for league start and solo self found. 
It can take you all the way from fresh start to end game.
It is completely made from rare items, that you can pick up or self craft. 
There are no uniques needed for this build. 

The passive tree, equipment and gem choices are balanced towards survivability. 

The build is also very flexible, and easy to change for your own playstyle.

The build uses many different minions and focus on spectres.


--

Required Uniques: none.
